text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Rice Shower—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Rice Shower was pointing,
I saw a claw crane game filled with
plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Since everyone's been turned into plushies,
I got a little curious...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though reserved, Rice Shower's
eyes are sparkling with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh... Are you really okay with that?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm worried about Rice's bad luck, but...
I'll be cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
